content: उपहारः .²1 An oblation. .²2 A gift, present (In general); रत्नपुष्पोपहारेण छायामानर्च पादयोः <ls>R. 4. 84</ls>; नृत्योपहारः <ls>Me. 34</ls>; <ls>K. 17</ls>, <ls n="K.">41</ls>, <ls n="K.">130</ls>, <ls n="K.">183</ls>. .²3 A victim, sacrifice, an offering to a deity; सपर्यां सपशूपहाराम् <ls>R. 16. 39</ls>; <ls>Māl. 1</ls>; उपहारीकृतास्मि <ls>Māl. 2</ls>; <ls>Ve. 4. 7</ls>. .²4 A complimentary gift, present to a superior <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 .³({%a%}) Offering of flowers <ab>&c.</ab>; flowery gifts; collection of flowers; म्लानपुष्पोपहारः <ls>R. 5. 74</ls>; <ls>Ku. 6. 42</ls>. .³({%b%}) Presents (to gods) of flowers <ab>&c.</ab>; materials of worship; गन्धैर्माल्यैः सुरभिभिर्बलिभिर्धूपदीपकैः . उच्चावचैश्चोपहारैः प्रवालफलतण्डुलैः . <ls>Bhāg. 10. 22. 3</ls>; <ls>V. 3</ls>; <ls>Śi. 11. 36</ls>. .²6 Honour. .²7 Indemnity, presents given as the price of peace; कपालसन्धिर्विज्ञेयः केवलं समसन्धितः . संप्रदानाद्भवति य उपहारः स उच्यते .. <ls>H. 4. 110</ls>. .²8 Food distributed to guests. .²9 Exultation, mirth (consisting of laughter, dance, singing <ab>&c.</ab>); कृतपुष्पोपहारा भूरधिकां पुष्यति श्रियम् <ls>Rām. 5. 11. 20</ls>.
